resources.string: When Bluetooth is on, the app searches for these and connects to the first one it finds — only one device at a time, in this order. Tick/untick to include or skip a device.
Always running — auto-start at phone restart/power-on and when Bluetooth turns on

How it works:
• Your devices must be paired with the phone once (use the Pair button above).
• After that, whenever Bluetooth turns on, the app searches and auto-connects: Roseland TWS RE-500 first, then itel T1Neo, then MusicMan BT-X78.
• Only one device is connected at a time. If your device disconnects, the app searches and reconnects automatically.
• For Samsung: set this app's battery to Unrestricted / Never sleeping apps so it stays alive.
Bluetooth is OFF — turn it on and your device will connect automatically.
Bluetooth on — searching for your devices…
Bluetooth permission needed — open the app and allow it
Connected (other device): %1$s — not connecting another one
None of your devices are paired yet — tap “Pair a device” in the app
Could not connect to %1$s — make sure it is on and nearby, it will keep retrying
Shows while BT Auto Connect is active
